name: bvdk-pstack-discipline
description: 27 writing-discipline and engineering-principle skills ported from cursor/plugins' pstack, adapted for Claude Code. 26 of the 27 set disable-model-invocation: true, so they only run when explicitly invoked, keeping them from competing with auto-invoked skills in other installed plugins (e.g. mattpocock-skills). unslop is the one exception: it's model-invoked, since no mattpocock skill overlaps with it.
